brief: 5 SaaS pricing models that print money in 2026. Tactical breakdown.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.headline: 5 Pricing Models That Print Money in 2026
slots.body: Most SaaS founders underprice their product. These five battle-tested models maximize revenue without killing conversions. Pick the right one for your 2026 growth.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Pay As You Grow Pricing
slots.body: Charge by API calls, seats, or storage consumed. Customers start small and scale spend with value received. It aligns revenue directly to customer success.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Good Better Best Tiers
slots.body: Three clear packages anchor perceived value. The middle tier drives 60% of sales by looking like the smart compromise. Never offer more than four options.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Land Then Expand Pricing
slots.body: Price the core product aggressively to win the account. Monetize through add-ons, modules, and premium support later. Expansion revenue is pure margin.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Pay For Outcomes Only
slots.body: Customers pay only when they achieve defined results. This builds extreme trust and locks in long contracts. It requires tight usage tracking but prints cash.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Real-Time Dynamic AI Pricing
slots.body: Adjust prices automatically based on demand, segment, and willingness to pay. AI models optimize every deal in real time. This maximizes yield without manual quoting.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Hybrid Stacks Win 2026
slots.body: The best founders combine two or three of these models. Hybrid pricing reduces churn and increases lifetime value. Test aggressively and iterate quarterly.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.headline: Which Pricing Model Will You Try?
slots.body: Drop your current model in the comments. I will reply with one tweak to increase your ARR.
